headline_marked: Seedance 2.5 [[launches video generation]] up to 30 seconds with multimodal referencing
headline: Seedance 2.5 launches video generation up to 30 seconds with multimodal referencing
summary: The new AI model can generate longer, more coherent video clips and offers advanced editing features for professional use.
details: Seedance 2.5, the latest iteration of the video creation model, has been officially launched. It builds on its predecessor's architecture with a focus on foundational and reference-based generation, aiming to enhance long-form storytelling, multimodal referencing, and editing capabilities for greater creative control and productivity.

The model can now generate high-quality, 30-second audio-video clips in a single pass, with support for multi-round extensions. This allows for the creation of longer videos with improved shot transitions and scene continuity, resulting in a more natural and polished visual output. Users can now produce multi-minute content with a consistent audiovisual language.

Seedance 2.5 significantly upgrades its multimodal referencing capabilities, allowing users to input up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio clips as reference materials. It also strengthens capabilities like clay render, motion, and creative references, enabling it to better interpret creator intent for complex ideas involving multiple subjects, scenes, and shot changes.

Editing has also seen precise upgrades, offering timestamp-level control for targeted audio and video content editing, boosting efficiency. Advanced features like green screen, camera perspective, and reference-based editing are enhanced to meet the demands of professional fields such as film and advertising.

The model's ability to generate a full story within a 30-second clip, rather than just extending a single moment, is a key advancement. For example, it can depict a singer's journey from backstage to a full concert performance in one continuous take.

Seedance 2.5 is now available on platforms like Jimeng AI and Doubao Pro, with API access coming soon via BytePlus ModelArk. This release aims to empower creators with more control and efficiency in bringing their ideas to life through AI-generated video.
